sloka: त्रिशिरास्तं प्रचिच्छेद शरैराशीविषोपमैः।स वृक्षं कृत्तमालोक्य उत्पपात तदा ऽङ्गदः ।। ६.७०.७ ।।
transliteration: triśirāstaṁ praciccheda śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ।sa vṛkṣaṁ kṛttamālokya utpapāta tadā 'ṅgadaḥ ।। 6.70.7 ।।

translations.english: Trisira split the trees with the arrows which were like venomous serpents. Observing Angada's action he flew up.
